value.name: Asha delays speaking to Marcus
value.description: Asha holds back the rehearsed line about rates and the Friday deadline, choosing silence instead of speaking to Marcus.
evidence: The rehearsed sentence about the rates and the Friday deadline was right there at the back of her teeth, and she did not say it; she pressed her thumb against the case until the edge bit and waited.

value.name: Asha watches over her father
value.description: Asha stays beside her father in bed, holding his hand and avoiding looking at him so she will not lose her nerve.
evidence: Her father shifted slightly under the blanket beside her, the hand she had been holding twitching once and settling, and she kept her eyes shut so she would not look at him and lose her nerve.

value.name: Rosa urges Asha to keep the silence
value.description: Rosa texts Asha to let the silence stretch and not hang up, reinforcing Asha's decision to wait for Marcus to speak first.
evidence: The phone buzzed against her ear with another message from Rosa—let the silence stretch, don't hang up—and she felt the instruction settle over what she was already doing, less a prompt than a confirmation that she was allowed to make him speak first.

value.name: Marcus hesitates to speak
value.description: Marcus exhales as if about to say something, but remains silent and gives Asha no response.
evidence: Marcus exhaled, the kind of breath a person takes before a word, and still did not give her one.

value.name: Rosa instructs Asha to listen for Marcus speaking
value.description: Rosa sends another message telling Asha to listen to Marcus's exhale because he is about to speak.
evidence: Rosa's next message came in while the line was still open, just one line on the screen against the blanket: listen to his exhale, he's about to speak.

value.name: Asha looks directly at her father
value.description: Asha opens her eyes and sees her father's face closely, noticing his fragile condition and realizing she has not looked at him this way without a clipboard before.
evidence: Asha read it and opened her eyes, and what she saw was not the rates column or the Friday deadline but her father's face turned slightly toward her on the pillow, the lower lip working once and then still, the skin at his temple thin enough that she could see the small blue vein under it.
She didn't know when she had last looked at him this way without a clipboard between them.

value.name: Asha admits her father is not waking
value.description: Asha quietly tells Marcus that her father is not waking up, beginning to say the rehearsed business line but stopping mid-thought.
